source_candidates.whole_hypothesis: The record instructs examination, inquiry and prognosis rather than treatment. Compare a patient’s appearance to healthy people and especially their own healthy baseline. Record the adverse face bundle. At onset ask about loss of sleep, loose bowels and want of food; a confessed explanation lowers danger but does not promise survival. Reassess over a day and night. Retain the source’s unresolved relation between absent causes and persistent signs in the severe branch. At the third/fourth day repeat those inquiries and add the face, body and eye observations. Keep later eyelid/sleep exclusions, severity levels, nasal motion and the final mortal-lips assertion.
source_candidates.consequence: Appearance remains the same when reported history changes the warranted prognosis. EXPLAINED_BY(finding,cause) produces reduced danger, not disappearance of the finding or guaranteed safety. The inquiry/time scopes must distinguish observation, explanation and judgment. No later invented consumer is required for that assertion-content distinction.

source_candidates.whole_hypothesis: The record gives propagation instructions over a named kind catalogue. Press emerged shoots down while raising their tips to allow rooting, then dig and plant straight at the proper time. Resume the full named list as all these kinds. Those wanted for more careful planting enter the pot/basket branch: thread a branch through a perforated container, fill and pack earth, leave it on the tree, then cut below and plant with its basket at the source’s two-year condition. Retain the separate vine branch with earth covering, a one-year delay and basket planting. Preserve uncertain antecedents and cut position.

source_candidates.whole_hypothesis: Two thirsty participants occupy different places at one stream. One alleges fouling against the other; the other rejects it using the direction of flow, and the narrator endorses the rebuttal. A second allegation concerns an offense six months earlier; the accused had not yet been born. The accuser shifts that alleged offense to the accused’s father, a new related person whose offense remains unverified. The accuser nevertheless kills the accused unjustly. The concluding generalization concerns oppression using invented causes, not proof of the accusations.
source_candidates.consequence: An allegation can be reported then rebutted without becoming a narrator assertion. Birth later than an alleged offense defeats that allegation; introducing a father changes the alleged agent, not the referent of every earlier pronoun. The final completed violent action neither proves the old allegations nor makes the father’s unverified charge true.
